functions.name: enforce_single_deck_zone
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION malign.enforce_single_deck_zone()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM malign.card_instances c
    WHERE c.game_id=NEW.game_id AND c.id=NEW.card_instance_id
      AND c.zone='DRAW_PILE' AND c.removed_from_game=false
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'M2A_SINGLE_ZONE_VIOLATION'
      USING ERRCODE='integrity_constraint_violation';
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END
$function$

functions.name: protect_card_zone_membership
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION malign.protect_card_zone_membership()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NEW.zone<>'DRAW_PILE' AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM malign.deck_card_positions p
    WHERE p.game_id=NEW.game_id AND p.card_instance_id=NEW.id
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'M2A_SINGLE_ZONE_VIOLATION'
      USING ERRCODE='integrity_constraint_violation';
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END
$function$

functions.name: protect_game_version_pins
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION malign.protect_game_version_pins()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NEW.ruleset_version_id <> OLD.ruleset_version_id
     OR NEW.scenario_definition_id <> OLD.scenario_definition_id
     OR NEW.card_registry_version_id <> OLD.card_registry_version_id
     OR NEW.engine_contract_version_id <> OLD.engine_contract_version_id
     OR NEW.ert_definition_id <> OLD.ert_definition_id
  THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'M2A_GAME_PIN_IMMUTABLE'
      USING ERRCODE = 'integrity_constraint_violation';
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END
$function$

functions.name: reject_historical_rewrite
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION malign.reject_historical_rewrite()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'M2A_APPEND_ONLY_VIOLATION:%', TG_TABLE_NAME
    USING ERRCODE = 'integrity_constraint_violation';
END
$function$

functions.name: seal_idempotency_result
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION malign.seal_idempotency_result()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'M2A_IDEMPOTENCY_DELETE_FORBIDDEN'
      USING ERRCODE = 'integrity_constraint_violation';
  END IF;

  IF OLD.status <> 'INTERNAL_PENDING'
     OR NEW.status <> 'COMMITTED'
     OR NEW.game_id <> OLD.game_id
     OR NEW.idempotency_key <> OLD.idempotency_key
     OR NEW.actor_id <> OLD.actor_id
     OR NEW.command_id <> OLD.command_id
     OR NEW.command_fingerprint <> OLD.command_fingerprint
     OR NEW.command_type <> OLD.command_type
     OR NEW.game_version_before <> OLD.game_version_before
     OR NEW.result_json IS NULL
     OR NEW.game_version_after IS NULL
  THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'M2A_IDEMPOTENCY_SEAL_VIOLATION'
      USING ERRCODE = 'integrity_constraint_violation';
  END IF;

  RETURN NEW;
END
$function$
